66→#define MM_CACHE_MODULE_VERSION  \"31.3.0\"   /* Semantic versioning       */\n    67→\n    68→#define MM_CACHE_DEFAULT_TBL_SIZE  2048u    /* Must be power-of-two      */\n    69→#define        128u\n    73→\n    74→#define unlikely(x) __builtin_expect(!!(x), 0)\n    75→\n    76→/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n    77→ * Data Types\n    78→ * -------------------------------------------------------------------------*/\n    79→typedef struct mm_cache_entry {\n    80→    char              *key;\n    81→    unsigned char     *payload;\n -------------------------------------------------------------------------*/\n   139→\n   140→/*\n   141→ * mm_cache_init\n   142→ *   171→\n   172→    if (pthread_rwlock_init(&c->rwlock, NULL) != 0)\n   173→        return errno;\n   174→\n   175→    mm_log(LOG_INFO, \"Response cache initialized (ver=%s, max_entries=%zu, \"\n   176→                     \"capacity=%zu KiB)\",\n   177→                     MM_CACHE_MODULE_VERSION,\n   178→                     max_entries,\n   179→                     capacity_bytes >> 10);\n   180→    return 0;\n   181→}\n   182→\n   183→/*\n   184→ * mm_cache_destroy\n   185→ * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n   186→ * Frees all memory associated with the cache.\n   187→ */\n   188→void mm_cache_destroy(mm_cache_t *c)\n   189→{\n   190→    if (!c) return;\n   191→\n   192→    pthread_rwlock_wrlock(&c->rwlock);\n   193→\n   194→ *payload,\n   232→                 size_t payload_len,\n   233→                 const char *content_type,\n   234→                 const char *etag,\n   235→                 uint32_t ttl_seconds)\n   236→{\n   237→    if (!c || !key || !payload || payload_len == 0)\n   238→        return EINVAL;\n   239→\n   240→    if (strlen(key) > MM_CACHE_MAX_KEYLEN)\n   241→        return ENAMETOOLONG;\n  247→    mm_cache_entry_t *new_entry = calloc(1, sizeof(*new_entry));\n   248→    if (!new_entry)\n   249→        return ENOMEM;\n   250→\n   251→    new_entry->key = strdup(key);\n   252→    if (strlen(content_type) > MM_CACHE_MAX_CONTENTTYPE) {\n   261→            free(new_entry->payload); free(new_entry->key); free(new_entry);\n   262→            return ENAMETOOLONG;\n   263→        }\n   264→        new_entry->content_type = strdup(content_type);\n   265→        if (!new_entry->content_type) goto oom;\n   266→    }\n   267→\n   268→    if (etag) {\n   269→        if (strlen(etag) > 273→        new_entry->etag = strdup(etag);\n   274→        if (!new_entry->etag) goto oom;\n   275→    }\n   276→\n   277→    new_entry->expiry_ts   = time(NULL) + ttl_seconds;\n   278→ 306→        existing->etag          = new_entry->etag;\n   307→\n   308→        /* Touch */\n   309→        mm_cache_lru_touch(c, existing);\n   310→\n   311→        free(new_entry->key); /* key identical */\n   312→        free(new_entry);      /* container freed */\n   313→    } else {\n   314→        /* Insert brand new entry */\n   315→        c->table[idx] = new_entry;\n   316→        c->entry_count++;\n   317→        c->current_bytes += payload_len;\n   318→\n   319→        /* Add to LRU head */\n   320→        new_entry->next = c->lru_head;\n   321→        if (c->lru_head)\n   322→            c->lru_head->prev = new_entry;\n   323→        c->lru_head = new_entry;\n   324→        if (!c->lru_tail)\n   325→            c->lru_tail = new_entry;\n   326→    }\n   327→\n   328→ 335→    free(new_entry->key);\n   336→    free(new_entry);\n   337→    return ENOMEM;\n   338→}\n   339→\n   340→/*\n   341→ * mm_cache_get\n   342→ * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n   343→ * Retrieves a cached response. Ownership of *payload_out is transferred to\n   344→ * the caller (caller must free). content_type_out & etag_out point to\n   345→ * internal strings – do not free, DO copy if retained beyond processing.\n   346→ *\n   347→ * Return:\n   348→ *   1  – cache HIT  (payload populated)\n   349→ *   0  – cache MISS\n   350→ *  <0  – negative errno on internal failure\n   351→ */\n   352→int mm_cache_get(mm_cache_t *c,\n   353→                 const char *key,\n   354→                 unsigned char **payload_out,\n   355→                 size_t *payload_len_out,\n   356→                 const char **content_type_out,\n   357→                 const char **etag_out,\n   358→                 uint32_t *age_out)\n   359→{\n   360→    if (!c || !key || !payload_out || !payload_len_out)\n   361→        return -EINVAL;\n   362→\n   363→    pthread_rwlock_rdlock(&c->rwlock);\n   364→\n   365→    uint64_t hash = mm_fnv1a_hash(key, strlen(key));\n   366→    size_t idx = hash & (c->tbl_size - 1);\n   367→\n   368→    while (c->table[idx] && strcmp(c->table[idx]->key, key) != 0)\n   369→        idx = (idx + 1) & (c->tbl_size - 1);\n   370→\n   371→    mm_cache_entry_t *e = c->table[idx];\n   372→\n   373→    /* Fast path: MISS */\n   374→    if (!e) {\n   375→        c->misses++;\n   376→        pthread_rwlock_unlock(&c->rwlock);\n   377→        return 0;\n   378→    }\n   379→\n   380→    /* Check expiration */\n   381→    time_t now = time(NULL);\n   382→    if (e->expiry_ts < now) {\n   383→        /* Upgrade to write lock to remove expired entry */\n   384→        pthread_rwlock_unlock(&c->rwlock);\n   385→        pthread_rwlock_wrlock(&c->rwlock);\n   386→\n   387→        /* ensure another thread hasn't removed it */\n   388→        if (c->table[idx] == e) {\n   389→            /* Detach from LRU */\n   390→            if (e->prev) e->prev->next = e->next;\n   391→            if (e->next) e->next->prev = e->prev;\n   392→            if (e == c->lru_head)   406→                size_t new_idx = mm_fnv1a_hash(move->key, strlen(move->key)) & (c->tbl_size - 1);\n   407→                while (c->table[new_idx])\n   408→                    new_idx = (new_idx + 1) & (c->tbl_size - 1);\n   409→                c->table[new_idx] = move;\n   410→                j = (j + 1) & (c->tbl_size - 1);\n   411→            }\n   412→\n   413→            free(e->key);\n   414→            free(e->payload);\n   415→            free(e->content_type);\n   416→            free(e->etag);\n   417→            free(e);\n   418→        }\n   419→\n   420→        c->misses++;\n   421→        pthread_rwlock_unlock(&c->rwlock);\n   422→        return 0;\n   423→    }\n   424→\n   425→    /* HIT */\n   426→    e->last_access = (uint64_t)clock();\n   427→    c->hits++;\n   428→\n   429→    /* Copy payload for caller */\n   430→    unsigned char *payload_dup = malloc(e->payload_len);\n   431→    if (!payload_dup) {\n   432→        pthread_rwlock_unlock(&c->rwlock);\n   433→        return -ENOMEM;\n   434→    }\n   435→    memcpy(payload_dup, e->payload, e->payload_len);\n   436→\n   437→    *payload_out      = payload_dup;\n   438→    *payload_len_out  = e->payload_len;\n   439→    if (content_type_out) *content_type_out = e->content_type;\n   440→    if (etag_out)        *etag_out          = e->etag;\n   441→    if (age_out)         *age_out           = (uint32_t)(now - (e->expiry_ts - now));\n   442→\n   443→    /* Defer LRU touch after releasing read lock to cut contention.          */\n   444→    pthread_rwlock_unlock(&c->rwlock);\n   445→\n   446→    pthread_rwlock_wrlock(&c->rwlock);\n   447→    mm_cache_lru_touch(c, e);\n   448→    pthread_rwlock_unlock(&c->rwlock);\n   449→\n   450→    return 1;\n   451→}\n   452→\n   453→/*\n   454→ * mm_cache_invalidate\n   455→ * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n   456→ * Removes a single entry from the cache (e.g. after POST/PUT/DELETE).\n   457→ */\n   458→void mm_cache_invalidate(mm_cache_t *c, const char *key)\n   459→{\n   460→    if (!c || !key) return;\n   461→    pthread_rwlock_wrlock(&c->rwlock);\n   462→\n   463→    uint64_t hash = mm_fnv1a_hash(key, strlen(key));\n   464→    size_t idx = hash & (c->tbl_size - 1);\n   465→\n   466→    while (c->table[idx] && strcmp(c->table[idx]->key, key) != 0)\n   467→        idx = (idx + 1) & (c->tbl_size - 1);\n   468→\n   469→    mm_cache_entry_t *e = c->table[idx];\n   470→    if (!e) {\n   471→        pthread_rwlock_unlock(&c->rwlock);\n   472→        return;\n   473→    }\n   474→\n   475→    /* Detach */\n   476→    if (e->prev) e->prev->next = e->next;\n   477→    if (e->next) e->next->prev = e->prev;\n   478→    if (e == c->lru_head) c->lru_head = e->next;\n   479→    if (e == c->lru_tail) c->lru_tail = e->prev;\n   480→\n   481→    c->table[idx] = NULL;\n   482→    c->entry_count--;\n   483→    c->current_bytes -= e->payload_len;\n   484→\n   485→    /* Rehash cluster */\n   486→    size_t j = (idx + 1) & (c->tbl_size - 1);\n   487→    while (c->table[j]) {\n   488→        mm_cache_entry_t *move = c->table[j];\n   489→        c->table[j] = NULL;\n   490→\n   491→        size_t new_idx = mm_fnv1a_hash(move->key, strlen(move->key)) & (c->tbl_size - 1);\n   492→        while (c->table[new_idx])\n   493→            new_idx = (new_idx + 1) & (c->tbl_size - 1);\n   494→        c->table[new_idx] = move;\n   495→\n   496→        j = (j + 1) & (c->tbl_size - 1);\n   497→    }\n   498→\n   499→    free(e->key);\n   500→    free(e->payload);\n   501→    free(e->content_type);\n   502→    free(e->etag);\n   503→    free(e);\n   504→\n   505→    pthread_rwlock_unlock(&c->rwlock);\n   506→    mm_log(LOG_DEBUG, \"Cache invalidated: %s\", key);\n   507→}\n   508→\n   509→/*\n   510→ * mm_cache_purge\n   511→ * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n   512→ * Removes every entry from the cache.\n   513→ */\n   514→void mm_cache_purge(mm_cache_t *c)\n   515→{\n   516→    if (!c) return;\n   517→    pthread_rwlock_wrlock(&c->rwlock);\n   518→\n   519→    for (size_t i = 0; i < c->tbl_size; ++i) {\n   520→        mm_cache_entry_t *e = c->table[i];\n   521→        if (e) {\n   522→            free(e->key);\n   523→            free(e->payload);\n   524→            free(e->content_type);\n   525→            free(e->etag);\n   526→            free(e);\n   527→        }\n   528→        c->table[i] = NULL;\n   529→    }\n   530→\n   531→    c->entry_count   = 0;\n   532→    c->current_bytes = 0;\n   533→    c->lru_head = c->lru_tail = NULL;\n   534→\n   535→    pthread_rwlock_unlock(&c->rwlock);\n   536→    mm_log(LOG_INFO, \"Cache fully purged\");\n   537→}\n   538→\n   539→/*\n   540→ * mm_cache_metrics_snapshot\n   541→ * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n   542→ * Captures a read-only snapshot of metrics for Prometheus scrape thread.\n   543→ */\n   544→void mm_cache_metrics_snapshot(const mm_cache_t *c,\n   545→                               mm_cache_metrics_t *out)\n   546→{\n   547→    if (!c || !out) return;\n   548→    pthread_rwlock_rdlock((pthread_rwlock_t *)&c->rwlock);\n   549→\n   550→    out->hits          = c->hits;\n   551→    out->misses        = c->misses;\n   552→    out->evictions     = c->evictions;\n   553→    out->entry_count   = c->entry_count;\n   554→    out->current_bytes = c->current_bytes;\n   555→\n   556→    pthread_rwlock_unlock((pthread_rwlock_t *)&c->rwlock);\n   557→}\n   558→\n   559→/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n   560→ * INTERNAL HELPERS\n   561→ * -------------------------------------------------------------------------*/\n   562→\n   563→/* Fowler-Noll-Vo hash */\n   564→static uint64_t mm_fnv1a_hash(const void *data, size_t len)\n   565→{\n   566→    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)data;\n   567→    uint64_t h = 14695981039346656037ULL; /* offset basis */\n   568→    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) {\n   569→        h ^= (uint64_t)p[i];\n   570→        h *= 1099511628211ULL;            /* FNV prime    */\n   571→    }\n   572→    return h;\n   573→}\n   574→\n   575→/* Resize hash table (called under write lock) */\n   576→static int mm_cache_grow_table(mm_cache_t *c, size_t new_size)\n   577→{\n   578→    mm_cache_entry_t **new_tbl = calloc(new_size, sizeof(*new_tbl));\n   579→    if (!new_tbl)\n   580→        return ENOMEM;\n   581→\n   582→    if (c->table) {\n   583→        for (size_t i = 0; i < c->tbl_size; ++i) {\n   584→            mm_cache_entry_t *e = c->table[i];\n   585→            if (!e) continue;\n   586→\n   587→            size_t idx = mm_fnv1a_hash(e->key, strlen(e->key)) & (new_size - 1);\n   588→            while (new_tbl[idx])\n   589→                idx = (idx + 1) & (new_size - 1);\n   590→            new_tbl[idx] = e;\n   591→        }\n   592→        free(c->table);\n   593→    }\n   594→    c->table    = new_tbl;\n   595→    c->tbl_size = new_size;\n   596→    return 0;\n   597→}\n   598→\n   599→/* Move entry to head (MRU) */\n   600→static void mm_cache_lru_touch(mm_cache_t *c, mm_cache_entry_t *e)\n   601→{\n   602→    if (e == c->lru_head) return; /* already MRU */\n   603→\n   604→    /* detach */\n   605→    if (e->prev) e->prev->next = e->next;\n   606→    if (e->next) e->next->prev = e->prev;\n   607→    if (e == c->lru_tail) c->lru_tail = e->prev;\n   608→\n   609→    /* insert at head */\n   610→    e->prev = NULL;\n   611→    e->next = c->lru_head;\n   612→    if (c->lru_head) c->lru_head->prev = e;\n   613→    c->lru_head = e;\n   614→    if (!c->lru_tail) c->lru_tail = e;\n   615→}\n   616→\n   617→/* Evict until under capacity constraints */\n   618→static void mm_cache_evict_if_needed(mm_cache_t *c, size_t add_bytes)\n   619→{\n   620→    while ( (c->entry_count >= c->max_entries) ||\n   621→            (c->current_bytes + add_bytes > c->capacity_bytes) )\n   622→    {\n   623→        mm_cache_entry_t *victim = c->lru_tail;\n   624→        if (!victim) break; /* Shouldn't happen */\n   625→\n   626→        /* Detach from list */\n   627→        if (victim->prev) victim->prev->next = NULL;\n   628→        c->lru_tail = victim->prev;\n   629→        if (victim == c->lru_head)\n   630→            c->lru_head = NULL;\n   631→\n   632→        /* Remove from hash table */\n   633→        size_t idx = mm_fnv1a_hash(victim->key, strlen(victim->key)) & (c->tbl_size - 1);\n   634→        while /* chain ptr */\n\n    if (e) {\n        /* Update in place */\n        lru_detach(g_cache, e);\n\n        g_cache->current_bytes -= e->payload_len;\n\n        void *new_payload = realloc(e->payload, len);\n        if (!new_payload) {\n            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_cache->lock);\n            return -ENOMEM;\n        }\n        e->payload = new_payload;\n        memcpy(e->payload, payload, len);\n        e->payload_len = len;\n\n        clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME_COARSE, &e->expires_at);\n        timespec_add_seconds(&e->expires_at, ttl_sec);\n\n        g_cache->current_bytes += len;\n        lru_insert_mru(g_cache, e);\n    } else {\n        /* Create new entry */\n        e = cache_entry_create(key, payload, len, ttl_sec);\n        if (!e) {\n            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_cache->lock);\n            return -ENOMEM;\n        }\n\n        /* Prepend to bucket chain */\n        e->next = *head;\n        *head   = e;\n\n        /* Add to LRU */\n        lru_insert_mru(g_cache, e);\n\n        g_cache->current_entries += 1;\n        g_cache->current_bytes   += (len + CACHE_ENTRY_OVERHEAD);\n    }\n\n    cache_trim_to_limit(g_cache);\n    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_cache->lock);\n    return 0;\n}\n\n/**\n * cache_get\n *\n * Attempt to retrieve a cache entry. Returns 0 on hit, 1 on miss,\n * negative on error.\n */\nint\ncache_get(const char *key, void **out_buf, size_t *out_len)\n{\n    if (!g_cache || !key || !out_buf || !out_len)\n        return -EINVAL;\n\n    *out_buf = NULL;\n    *out_len = 0;\n\n    struct timespec now;\n    clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME_COARSE, &now);\n\n    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_cache->lock);\n\n    uint64_t bucket_idx = freq_hash64(key, strlen(key)) % g_cache->bucket_count;\n    cache_entry_t **head = &g_cache->buckets[bucket_idx];\n    cache_entry_t *e = *head;\n\n    while (e && strcmp(e->key, key) != 0)\n        e = e->next; /* expired -> treat as miss */\n    }\n\n    /* Hit -> promote to MRU */\n    lru_detach(g_cache, e);\n    lru_insert_mru(g_cache, e);\n\n    /* Copy payload */\n    void *buf = malloc(e->payload_len);\n    if (!buf) {\n        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_cache->lock);\n        return -ENOMEM;\n    }\n    memcpy(buf, e->payload, e->payload_len);\n    *out_buf = buf;\n    *out_len = e->payload_len;\n\n    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_cache->hits, 1, memory_order_relaxed);\n    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_cache->lock);\n    return 0; /* hit */\n}\n\n/**\n * cache_invalidate\n *\n * Removes entry if present.  Returns 0 if removed, 1 if not found, negative on\n * errors.\n */\nint\ncache_invalidate(const char *key)\n{\n    if (!g_cache || !key)\n        return -EINVAL;\n\n    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_cache->lock);\n    uint64_t bucket_idx = freq_hash64(key, strlen(key)) % g_cache->bucket_count;\n    cache_entry_t **cur = &g_cache->buckets[bucket_idx];\n    cache_entry_t *e = *cur;\n\n    while (e && strcmp(e->key, key) != 0) {\n        cur = &e->next;\n        e = e->next;\n    }\n\n    if (!e) {\n        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_cache->lock);\n        return 1; /* not found */\n    }\n\n    /* Remove */\n    *cur = e->next;\n    lru_detach(g_cache, e);\n\n    g_cache->current_entries -= 1;\n    g_cache->current_bytes   -= (e->payload_len + CACHE_ENTRY_OVERHEAD);\n    cache_entry_destroy(e);\n    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_cache->lock);\n    return 0;\n}\n\n/**\n * cache_metrics_snapshot\n *\n * Exposes statistics for Prometheus scrape.\n */\nvoid\ncache_metrics_snapshot(uint64_t *hits,\n                       uint64_t *misses,\n                       uint64_t *evictions,\n                       size_t   *current_entries,\n                       size_t   *current_bytes)\n{\n    if (!g_cache) return;\n    if (hits)      *hits      = atomic_load_explicit(&g_cache->hits, memory_order_relaxed);\n    if (misses)    *misses    = atomic_load_explicit(&g_cache->misses, memory_order_relaxed);\n    if (evictions) *evictions = atomic_load_explicit(&g_cache->evictions, memory_order_relaxed);\n\n    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_cache->lock);\n    if (current_entries) *current_entries = g_cache->current_entries;\n    if (current_bytes)   *current_bytes   = g_cache->current_bytes;\n    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_cache->lock);\n}\n\n/**\n * cache_shutdown\n *\n * Frees all resources. i < cache->bucket_cnt; ++i) {\n        mm_cache_entry_t *e = cache->buckets[i];\n        while (e) {\n            mm_cache_entry_t *next = e->hnext;\n            mm_cache_free_entry(e);\n            e = next;\n        }\n    }\n    free(cache->buckets);\n\n    pthread_rwlock_unlock(&cache->lock);\n    pthread_rwlock_destroy(&cache->lock);\n    free(cache);\n\n    MM_LOG_INFO(\"Response cache destroyed\");\n}\n\nstatic inline time_t\nmm_now_sec(void)\n{\n    return time(NULL);\n}\n\n/*\n * Return NULL on miss / expired        – misses++ on both conditions\n * Return malloc()-ed blob on hit       – caller must free(*payload)\n *\n * out_size may be NULL if caller doesn't need blob length.\n */\nuint8_t *\nmm_cache_get(mm_cache_t *cache,\n             const char *key,\n             size_t *out_size)\n{\n    if (!cache || !key) {\n        errno = EINVAL;\n        return NULL;\n    }\n\n    uint64_t h = mm_fnv1a_hash(key);\n    size_t bucket_idx = h & (cache->bucket_cnt - 1);\n\n    pthread_rwlock_rdlock(&cache->lock);\n\n    mm_cache_entry_t *e;\n    for (e = cache->buckets[bucket_idx]; e; e = e->hnext) {\n        if (strcmp(e->key, key) == 0) break;\n    }\n\n    if (!e) {\n        atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&cache->misses, 1, memory_order_relaxed);\n        pthread_rwlock_unlock(&cache->lock);\n        return NULL; /* miss */\n    }\n\n    /* Check TTL */\n    if ((uint64_t)(mm_now_sec() - e->created_at_epoch) > cache->ttl_sec) {\n        /* Upgrade to write lock to evict */\n        pthread_rwlock_unlock(&cache->lock);\n        pthread_rwlock_wrlock(&cache->lock);\n        mm_cache_unlink(cache, e);\n        atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&cache->misses, 1, memory_order_relaxed);\n        atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&cache->evictions, 1, memory_order_relaxed);\n        mm_cache_free_entry(e);\n        pthread_rwlock_unlock(&cache->lock);\n        return NULL; /* expired */\n    }\n\n    /* Hit! Copy payload for safe return */\n    uint8_t *copy = malloc(e->size);\n    if (!copy) {\n        pthread_rwlock_unlock(&cache->lock);\n        return NULL; /* errno set */\n    }\n    memcpy(copy, e->blob, e->size);\n    if (out_size) *out_size = e->size;\n\n    /* Move to front (MRU) if not already */\n    if (cache->mru != e) {\n        /* Upgrade to write lock (lock upgrade pattern) */\n        pthread_rwlock_unlock(&cache->lock);\n        pthread_rwlock_wrlock(&cache->lock);\n        mm_cache_lru_move_to_front(cache, e);\n        pthread_rwlock_unlock(&cache->lock);\n    } else {\n        pthread_rwlock_unlock(&cache->lock);\n    }\n\n    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&cache->hits, 1, memory_order_relaxed);\n    return copy;\n}\n\n/*\n * Insert or update an item (deep-copies blob).\n * Returns 0 on success, ‑1 on allocation error.\n */\nint\nmm_cache_put(mm_cache_t *cache,\n             const char *key,\n             const uint8_t *blob,\n             size_t size)\n{\n    if (!cache || !key || !blob || !size) {\n        errno = EINVAL;\n        return -1;\n    }\n\n    mm_cache_entry_t *new_e = NULL;\n\n    /* Allocate outside lock to minimize critical-section */\n    new_e = calloc(1, sizeof(*new_e));\n    if (!new_e) return -1;\n\n    new_e->key = strdup(key);\n    if (!new_e->key) {\n        free(new_e);\n        return -1;\n    }\n\n    new_e->blob = malloc(size);\n    if (!new_e->blob) {\n        free(new_e->key);\n        free(new_e);\n        return -1;\n    }\n    memcpy(new_e->blob, blob, size);\n    new_e->size              = size;\n    new_e->created_at_epoch  = mm_now_sec();\n\n    uint64_t h = mm_fnv1a_hash(key);\n    size_t bucket_idx = h & (cache->bucket_cnt - 1);\n\n    pthread_rwlock_wrlock(&cache->lock);\n\n    /* Replace existing? */\n    mm_cache_entry_t *e;\n    for (e = cache->buckets[bucket_idx]; e; e = e->hnext) {\n        if (strcmp(e->key, key) == 0) break;\n    }\n    if (e) {\n        /* Update in place (retain list placement) */\n        free(e->blob);\n        free(e->key);\n\n        e->key              = new_e->key;\n        e->blob             = new_e->blob;\n        e->size             = new_e->size;\n        e->created_at_epoch = new_e->created_at_epoch;\n\n        free(new_e); /* only wrapper */\n        mm_cache_lru_move_to_front(cache, e);\n    } else {\n        /* Insert into bucket chain head */\n        new_e->hnext          = cache->buckets[bucket_idx];\n        cache->buckets[bucket_idx] = new_e;\n\n        /* Insert into MRU list front */\n        new_e->next = cache->mru;\n        if (cache->mru)\n            cache->mru->prev = new_e;\n        cache->mru = new_e;\n        if (!cache->lru)\n            cache->lru = new_e;\n\n        cache->size++;\n\n        /* Eviction if overflow */\n        if (cache->size > cache->capacity) {\n            mm_cache_evict_lru(cache);\n        }\n    }\n\n    pthread_rwlock_unlock(&cache->lock);\n    return 0;\n}\n\nint\nmm_cache_remove(mm_cache_t *cache, const char *key)\n{\n    if (!cache || !key) {\n        errno = EINVAL;\n        return -1;\n    }\n\n    uint64_t h = mm_fnv1a_hash(key);\n    size_t bucket_idx = h & (cache->bucket_cnt - 1);\n\n    pthread_rwlock_wrlock(&cache->lock);\n\n    mm_cache_entry_t **pp = &cache->buckets[bucket_idx];\n    for (;
